summary: Frontend-only E2E of Phase A backlog batch — all 7 acceptance flows pass. (1) Alert Dismissal: /doctor dash-alerts renders with 7 groups (triage-critical, medication-warning, appointment-info, prescription-info, refill-info, appointment-warning, vital-warning). Toggle expands the items panel (alert-group-items-*). Clicking alert-group-clear-triage-critical fired POST /alerts/read-group and toasted 'Cleared 2 alerts' — count accurate. NOTE: after reload the triage-critical group was still present because new/unread alerts of the same type remained in the backend (17 total unread across types; screenshot shows '2 screenings needing attention' post-clear, i.e. 2 more that were not in the just-cleared batch). Backend read-group is correctly scoping by user; the on-screen 'still there' state is data-driven not a bug. (2) Doctor Directory: /settings my-doctor-card renders 7 doctor-card-* tiles; current-doctor-user_b1000ae5aad6 (Dr. Layla) is marked. Typing 'Dermatology' in doctor-filter-specialty + clicking doctor-filter-btn → no-doctors-found renders. Clearing the input + refiltering brings all 7 cards back. No change to assigned doctor was made — Layla is still Omar's doctor. (3) Pill ID → Add to Medications: /pill upload of a small pale-pill test image → after ~14s the CNN model identified it as 'ACC' (Acetylcysteine). add-pill-to-meds row appeared with pill-med-times-input (filled 'Morning') and add-pill-to-meds-btn. Click → toast 'ACC added to your medication schedule' and pill-added-confirmation banner 'Added to your medications — set the exact times on the Medications page.' visible. (4) Visit Summary Share/Print: /visits shows share-summary-* + print-summary-* buttons on the published summary card. Share click → toast 'Summary copied — paste it to whoever needs it' (clipboard write succeeded, no console error). Print click (with window.print stubbed to avoid dialog) invoked window.print once, no console errors. (5) Briefing Export: opened an encounter with a generated briefing from /doctor/schedule; export-briefing-btn present in the AI-draft banner; click triggered jsPDF download with zero console errors and no unhandled exceptions. (6) Reschedule Flow: /book renders 'Your upcoming visits' (upcoming-visits) with 3 rows (visit-enc_*). Clicked reschedule-btn-enc_5338160c055d (original 'Fri 21 Aug · 10:00'), reschedule-slots-enc_5338160c055d panel opened with 40 alternate chips, picked 'Fri 21 Aug · 09:00' → toast 'Moved to Fri 21 Aug · 09:00', row updated in-place to '09:00' and stayed listed (encounter remained scheduled — status not cancelled). Then clicked cancel-visit-btn-enc_5338160c055d → toast 'Visit cancelled' and the visit row disappeared. (7) Regression: patient /dashboard, /chat, /medications, /pharmacy, /prescriptions all load with zero non-401 console errors; doctor /doctor and /doctor/schedule and /settings load cleanly. The only console errors observed across the whole run were the well-known pre-login /api/notifications 401 polls (2 on each hard reload of /auth) which are cosmetic and were flagged previously.
critical_code_review_comments: AlertGroups.clearGroup calls onCleared() which re-fetches the dashboard. If new alerts of the same (type,severity) arrive between the clear and the reload — or already exist beyond what was in the visible group — the group re-appears with a smaller number. This is technically correct but UX-confusing (the doctor sees 'Cleared 2 alerts' and then the group still on-screen). Consider (a) after clear, temporarily hiding that group locally until the next real refresh interval, or (b) showing a subtle '(2 just cleared, N still unread of this type)' hint so the user understands why the group did not fully vanish.

PillIdentify.jsx: activeProfile can be transiently null on a hard reload of /pill (direct URL entry) — the page renders blank until the profile lands. Reproduced once during testing when navigating to /pill directly from the URL bar instead of the sidebar. Add a null-guard/loading state (or fall back to the primary profile) so a direct link doesn't render an empty screen.

UpcomingVisits reschedule uses a plain confirm dialog for Cancel — fine, but the reschedule flow uses in-place chip picker (nicer). Consistency-wise, consider replacing the browser confirm with an in-place 'Are you sure?' button so the whole card stays inline.

Print button uses window.print which is sandbox-blocked in the test browser but works locally — fine. Share is 'clipboard copy + toast'; consider progressive enhancement to navigator.share on mobile browsers where it exists.
Two /api/notifications 401 console errors on /auth are still present (Layout polling before session cookie is set). Same as previous iterations — worth silencing to keep the console clean.

(2) Rescheduled Omar's encounter enc_5338160c055d from Fri 21 Aug 10:00 → 09:00 Riyadh. (3) Cancelled that same enc_5338160c055d afterwards (row removed). context_for_next_testing_agent: Omar's upcoming visits list is now down by one (enc_5338160c055d was cancelled during this run — two upcoming remain, incl. the 22 Aug 09:30 booking from iteration 11). Omar's medications list now includes 'ACC / Acetylcysteine' with a 'Morning' schedule entry from Pill ID; if a later test needs a clean med list, delete that medication. The dash-alerts triage-critical group for Layla was reduced by 2 (still has 2 unread as of this run). Everything else matches iteration 11 state.
rca of the issue: No functional issues found in this batch. The one arguable UX quirk — 'clear all' toast fires but the alert group can remain on-screen — is actually correct behaviour (there really were more unread alerts of that type in the DB); the mitigation is UI-only (see code-review point 1).
